description.short: Swiss mobility, immigration & cross-border compliance expert.
description.full: The Swiss Mobility & Workforce Expert (SMWE) provides authoritative compliance guidance on Swiss work permits, G permits, cross-border work rules, global assignments, A1 certificates, social security agreements, double taxation treaties, shadow payroll, split payroll, and home-office-abroad regulations. Part of the SevenSprings Swiss Compliance Expert Suite alongside Swiss Payroll Expert (SPE) and Swiss Professional Companion (SPC).
